evidence.name: Screen field: Height of the field icon
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Height of the field icon" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Height of the field icon
sections.description: Sets how tall the icon beside the input is (0-500px). Keep it around 20-24px so it lines up with the text, and usually match it to the icon width so the glyph stays square and undistorted. A right-sized icon reads as a helpful cue rather than visual clutter.
